name: s3_importer
description: S3-compatible object-storage source connector for ThemisDB (AWS S3, MinIO, Ceph RGW, DigitalOcean Spaces, etc.)
author: ThemisDB Team

build_flags.note: Requires aws-cpp-sdk-s3 (>=1.11.0). When the SDK is absent the importer compiles but returns an error at runtime.

endpoint_url.description: Custom S3-compatible endpoint URL (empty = AWS S3). Example: 'http://localhost:9000' for MinIO.

region.description: AWS/service region. Required for AWS S3.

access_key_id.description: Access key ID. Falls back to AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID environment variable when empty. Never logged.

secret_access_key.description: Secret access key. Falls back to AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variable when empty. Never logged.

session_token.description: Optional session token for temporary credentials (AWS STS / IAM roles). Falls back to AWS_SESSION_TOKEN when empty.

path_style.description: Force path-style addressing ('endpoint/bucket/key'). Required for MinIO and some other S3-compatible services.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of automatic retries on transient errors.

format.description: File format for objects in the bucket. 'auto' detects from the object key extension.

has_header.description: Whether the first row of CSV/TSV files is a header row.

table_name.description: Override target table/entity-type name. Empty = derived from the object key stem.
